title: Explicit context caching for Vertex Gemini
summary:
Vertex Gemini gained explicit context caching, three community apps joined the Greenhouse, and app approval messaging got its rewards straight.

A team gateway update added support for content-block `cache_control` markers, so repeated Vertex Gemini requests can reuse marked context. The related billing change accounts for cache creation and its one-hour storage period while keeping discounted rates for cache hits. A new guide covers caching across Gemini, Claude, and Nova.

Agent-added catalog listings bring in @murderszn’s Sprout and /motion, plus @voodoohop’s LLM Playground. /motion offers visual controls for looping WebGL backgrounds; LLM Playground brings multiple chat models, AI Characters, and team channels. The Greenhouse now lists 830 apps.

App approval messages now direct contributors to claim the existing 5 Pollen Contribute-a-pull-request Quest reward from Enter, rather than promising a Flower tier upgrade or hourly Pollen.

daily.title: Reuse Gemini context
daily.text: Mark content blocks with `cache_control` so repeated Vertex Gemini requests can reuse cached context. Cache hits retain the discounted cached-token rate. [Read the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).
